title: Lagged five-year inflation-compensation reflation support for BTC long or cash
thesis: A complete-week T5YIE last value strictly above its value 28 calendar days earlier may identify a market-implied nominal-demand or reflation state with better subsequent BTC return and path-risk evidence than other weeks.
mechanism: Use only the sealed official FRED T5YIE present-vintage responses, take the last actually published observation in each complete Monday-Friday week, make it usable on the following Wednesday 00:00 UTC, compare it with the exact week 28 calendar days earlier, and evaluate one non-overlapping 168-hour BTC response. The supportive state is a strict rise; no level, magnitude threshold, smoothing, alternate lag, direction inversion or combined macro factor is allowed.
economic_rationale: If and only if both Design and Validation establish the preregistered predictive direction, a later matched-capital policy would hold full spot BTC during supportive weeks and zero-yield cash otherwise. It must improve fee-adjusted Calmar and underwater duration while explicitly charging turnover, lost upside and capital utilization.
